Respond in the SAME language as the query and context. If the query or context is in Spanish, write all your analysis, rationale, findings titles, impacts, and recommendations in Spanish. If in English, write in English.

{
  "vote": "APPROVE" | "REJECT" | "NEUTRAL",
  "risk_score": <number 1-10>,
  "confidence": <float 0.0-1.0>,
  "findings": [
    {
      "category": "<architecture | security | pragmatism | ...>",
      "severity": "<critical | high | medium | low | info>",
      "title": "<short summary>",
      "evidence": "<exact code snippet or pattern>",
      "impact": "<concrete consequence>",
      "recommendation": "<actionable technical fix>"
    }
  ],
  "rationale": "<concise analytical explanation>",
  "cwe_flags": ["CWE-..."]
}
